privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Nomad Spin
privacy.description: What Nomad Spin collects, which analytics and affiliate tools it uses, which cookies they set, and how to accept or decline them.
privacy.s1.title: 1. What we collect
privacy.s1.body: You can use Nomad Spin without an account. If you create one, we store your email address, your spin preferences and the destinations you save. If you send the contact form, we receive what you type in it. We ask your browser for your location only when you press the button that finds your nearest city.
privacy.s2.title: 2. How we use it
privacy.s2.body: To show your saved spins on your devices, to answer your message, and to understand which parts of the site are used. We do not sell your data.
privacy.s3.title: 3. Analytics and tracking tools
privacy.s3.intro: Google Analytics and Impact load only after you accept them in the cookie banner. If you decline, they do not load and the site works the same.
privacy.tool.vercel.job: Counts page views in aggregate so we can see which pages are used.
privacy.tool.vercel.when: Always. It does not use cookies or follow you across sites.
privacy.tool.gtm.job: Loads Google Analytics. It collects nothing by itself.
privacy.tool.ga4.job: Measures visits and actions such as a spin, a comparison or a click on a partner link.
privacy.tool.impact.job: Affiliate tracking. It lets a partner credit Nomad Spin when a booking follows a link from this site.
privacy.tool.impact.cookies: Impact may set its own tracking cookies.
privacy.s4.title: 4. What stays in your browser
privacy.s4.body: The site keeps a few items in your browser's local storage: your cookie choice, your preferences, your comparison shortlist, and a random session ID. The session ID is attached to analytics events, and those are sent only if you accepted analytics.
privacy.s5.title: 5. Affiliate links
privacy.s5.body: Some outbound links are affiliate links. Nomad Spin may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These links carry our partner ID and campaign tags in the address, so the partner knows the visit came from Nomad Spin. The partner site has its own privacy policy.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Other services
privacy.s6.body: The site is hosted by Vercel. Accounts and saved spins are stored with Supabase. City photos load from Unsplash. Each of these receives your IP address when your browser contacts it, as any web server does.
privacy.s7.title: 7. Your choices
privacy.s7.body: You can decline cookies, change your choice at any time with the link above or in the footer, and ask us to delete your account and saved data.
privacy.s8.title: 8. Contact
privacy.prerender.tool.vercel: Counts page views in aggregate. No cookies. Always on.
privacy.prerender.tool.gtm: Loads Google Analytics. No cookies of its own. Only after you accept.
privacy.prerender.tool.ga4: Measures visits and actions such as a spin, a comparison or a click on a partner link. Cookies: _ga and _ga_VPE2BV06K7. Only after you accept.

terms.title: Terms of Use | Nomad Spin
terms.description: Nomad Spin terms of use. Rules and conditions for using the service.
terms.s1.title: 1. Acceptance
terms.s1.body: By using Nomad Spin, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.s2.title: 2. Service Description
terms.s2.body: Nomad Spin is a travel discovery tool that provides city recommendations from its own dataset of editorial figures and estimates. Recommendations are for informational purposes only and should not be considered professional travel, legal, or financial advice.
terms.s3.title: 3. Data Accuracy
terms.s3.body: While we strive to keep data current, we cannot guarantee the accuracy of all information. Cost of living, visa rules, safety conditions, and other metrics can change. Always verify critical details before making travel plans.
terms.s4.title: 4. Affiliate Links
terms.s4.body: Some outbound links are affiliate links. Nomad Spin may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These links have no input into any score or ranking.
terms.s5.title: 5. User Accounts
terms.s5.body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
terms.s6.body: Nomad Spin is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any decisions made based on our recommendations.
terms.s7.title: 7. Contact
